name: BOOKS
description:
Iskanje po knjigah pri nas, v dveh korakih.

Nove knjige — iskalnik vpraša Mladinsko knjigo (emka), po želji tudi Bolho, kjer knjige prodajajo posamezniki.

Antikvariat — rabljene knjige. Slovenski antikvarti zavrnejo Tor in stran jih ne more vprašati sama, zato celica pokaže zadnji zabeleženi pregled z datumom in povezave v njihove iskalnike. Kjer iskalnik sprejme naslov v povezavi, se odpre že z vpisanim naslovom.
descriptionEn:
A book lookup in Slovene shops, in two steps.

New books — it asks Mladinska knjiga (emka) and, on request, Bolha classifieds.

Antikvariat — used books. The Slovene antiquariats refuse Tor and a page cannot ask them itself, so the cell shows the most recent recorded sweep with its date and links into each shop's own search. Where the shop's search takes a title in the address, it opens with the title already in it.
